svg.title: What a result shows
svg.desc: The search of Paperless-ngx sends the title of document 412, its date 2026-08-12, the IDs of its correspondent and its type, 3 and 1, and the words around the term. Paperless names correspondent 3 Northstar Energy and type 1 Bill, with one request per kind for all documents of the page, which the app keeps for ten minutes. The file of the document in Nextcloud gives the preview, when Nextcloud draws previews of its type, or else the icon of the type, as the search of files shows them. The result shows that picture, the title Electricity invoice - August 2026, and below it Aug 12, 2026 · Northstar Energy · Bill — Invoice E-2026-0812. Total due 84.30 EUR by September 2, with the date in the language of the user, such as 12.08.2026 in German.
